* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 4 release ([[Virtual Set 4]]); Players Committee card image<ref name="ht0">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/wereleaving.gif wereleaving.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 022435b "Set 9 load", 8 July 2018.</ref>. * '''PC-E1''' ([[We're Leaving (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="ht1">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/wereleaving.gif wereleaving.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit e8445f0 "Fixing case and making gifs", 1 June 2022.</ref>: “Deploy on table. A version because the change is visible on the card (Bill, 12 November 2026). No errata mark. The card prints the errata mark “none” although this is change 1 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). * '''PC-E2''' ([[We're Leaving (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image, marked “E1”<ref name="ht2">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/wereleaving.gif wereleaving.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 6f23e07 "Fixing case and making gifs", 9 March 2026.</ref>: “Deploy on table. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' the text after “Deploy on table.” was replaced: “If your Podracer is on table and opponent's is not, they generate no Force at Podrace Arena. Once during opponent's control phase, if you are winning (or have won) a Podrace, may stack the bottom card of your Lost Pile on Credits Will Do Fine.” No errata sheet for this change has been found; the PC card data changed on 15 March 2026. The card prints the errata mark “E1” although this is change 2 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). This is the current text. Before/after: [[File:V4-L-Were_Leaving_(V)-compare-e8445f0-6f23e07.png|440px]]
